name: @synapcores/openclaw-memory
description: OpenClaw long-term memory plugin backed by your own self-hosted SynapCores AIDB gateway. Passive by default (explicit memory_store/recall/forget tools); an OPT-IN lifecycle, off by default, can proactively capture conversation-derived personal facts at the end of each agent turn and before context compaction. Data stays in your gateway — no third-party egress.
author: SynapCores Team <release@synapcores.com>

install._minSynapCoresEngineVersionNote: Unchanged at v1.8.5-ce: v0.7.0 stays backward compatible with the legacy MEMORY_* backend and auto-detects. Two features need newer engines. (1) The CREATE MEMORY backend -- memory_current / memory_trace, per-identity scoping, prompt_ready recall -- needs v1.14.3-ce. (2) memory.identityFrom='credential' (the default) additionally needs an engine build that MINTS the memory_identity pin on login; earlier v1.14.3 builds enforce the claim but never populate it, so credential mode fails there with MEMORY_CREDENTIAL_UNPINNED and the fix is memory.identityFrom='static' or 'host'. Legacy, 'static' and 'host' modes need nothing beyond v1.8.5-ce.
